startup:
FailAt 21
Assign Developer: SYS:Developer
MakeDir RAM:CEFProfile
Assign PROFILE: RAM:CEFProfile
Stack 1048676
Assign AROSTCP: SYS:System/Network/AROSTCP
Run <NIL: >RAM:AROSTCP-startup.log QUIET AROSTCP:C/AROSTCP
C:WaitForPort AROSTCP
Run >RAM:CEF-host.log Execute S:CEFHost-Run
C:CEFHostProbe wait
Echo Host-ready-RC:$RC
C:CEFHost T:CEFHostProfiles --allow-stop
Echo Duplicate-host-RC:$RC
Run >RAM:CEF-clientA.log C:CEFHostProbe clientA 250
Wait 1
Run >RAM:CEF-clientB.log C:CEFHostProbe clientB 600 1
Wait 7
C:CEFHostProbe stats
Wait 7
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFHostProbe clientC 0
C:CEFHostProbe stop
Type RAM:CEF-clientA.log
Type RAM:CEF-clientB.log
Wait 5
Type RAM:CEF-host.log >DEBUG:
Echo Host-test-finished
Wait 3600
